headline.text: L3 Truffle Line belt found folded and *cut* after cleaning — running but damage severe; L3 ML4 filter vacuum incomplete at startup.

summary: One active foreign-material concern — damaged conveyor belt with visible cut at L3 Truffle Line is running but flagged for Monday resolution. Two cleaning gaps: L3 ML4 filter vacuum not completed (linked to rejected chocolate), L1 non-allergen items deferred to Monday after barrel wash took over the area.

food_safety.title: Damaged belt with cut running on Truffle Line
food_safety.summary: Speed-up table belt (after Gallatin) found folded over with visible cut during post-clean inspection; currently running but damage severe enough to warrant weekend replacement discussion.
food_safety.status: Open — belt is running as of 07:12; management asked for weekend repair assessment.

food_safety.title: Inclusion hopper vacuum dropped during cleaning, wire ripped
food_safety.summary: Vacuum for ML1 inclusion hopper dropped when ring clamp popped open while moving; wire torn off during fall; maintenance repaired wire and bracket by 04:42.
food_safety.status: Resolved on shift — wire fixed by Kavin, hopper reassembled and back in service.

quality.title: Inkjet code date doesn't fit inside flow wrap on ML2
quality.summary: 12g changeover completed except inkjet printer setup — code date prints outside flow-wrap boundary; line lead unable to adjust, maintenance also unable to resolve.
quality.status: Open, deferred to Monday startup — staged for production but coding issue unresolved.

sanitation.title: Non-allergen items not cleaned after barrel wash took over area
sanitation.summary: Non-allergen wash area used all night for 48 barrels; some non-allergen items unable to be cleaned as a result and deferred to Monday completion.
sanitation.status: Open — cleaning incomplete at shift end, scheduled for Monday finish.

sanitation.title: Sprayer tool from drain area found in washroom
sanitation.summary: Sprayer used on drains was moved to ML1 washroom; flagged to prevent return to equipment service without proper identification and sanitization.
sanitation.status: Resolved on shift — sprayer segregated in washroom.

sanitation.title: ML4 TG4 filter vacuum not completed during cleaning
sanitation.summary: Filter vacuum on TG4 was skipped during level-2 clean; operator flagged it as root cause of rejected chocolate issues and completed it during day shift.
sanitation.status: Resolved on shift — filter vacuum cleaned during 3rd shift before production start.

opportunities.text: Review labeling on sanitation tools — the sprayer used on drains nearly went back into equipment service at ML1.
Consider capacity planning for wash-area conflicts — tonight's barrel backlog prevented completion of non-allergen item cleaning.
Consider adding ring-clamp safety pins to inclusion hopper handling SOP — today's vacuum drop at ML1 cited missing safety pin as cause, echoing need for fall-prevention hardware.
Review ML4 level-2 checklist to include filter vacuum as mandatory sign-off — today's skip was linked by the operator to ongoing rejected-chocolate issues.
